title: Chapter 1426 - 7: Is That The 'Galaxy'? (Part 2)

Chapter 1426 - 7: Is That The 'Galaxy'? (Part 2)

Chapter 1426 - 7: Is That the 'Galaxy'? (Part 2)

"Not bad luck."

Lin Yuan said.

Being able to acquire such a Time Mountain is indeed quite fortunate.

Of course, blocking the Bald Time Lord afterward relied on strength.

Without strength, Lin Yuan would really just be a newly promoted ordinary Time Lord.

Then, in all likelihood, he wouldn't have been able to keep the Time Mountain in the end.

The Bald Time Lord initially suggested splitting it in half to test Lin Yuan.

If he found Lin Yuan's strength ordinary, easily manipulated by him,

how could he possibly settle for just half?

"In a place like Wanwei Space-Time, you do need luck."

The Twelve-Eyed Beast nodded, as within Wanwei Space-Time, the timeline cannot be observed; Time Lords cannot predict the future, so luck plays a big role.

"But you also have to be careful, it's very dangerous there too."

The Twelve-Eyed Beast reminded: "Especially deep inside, second-level lords fight fiercely over treasures, I've heard several second-level lords have gone mad with killing, their main fighting bodies have fallen."

"Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Wanting to make second-level Time Lords kill with such madness, the treasures they fight over must be extraordinarily precious, likely surpassing the value of the Time Mountain.

Within Wanwei Space-Time, without observing the timeline, the outcomes of battles among the lords cannot be known in advance, leaving direct combat as the only way to determine victory or defeat.

And in direct combat, to a certain extent, neither party can hold back, and it's not surprising for one side's main fighting body to fall.

"If you really encounter any danger, remember to mention my name; as long as it's not a legendary-level lord, it might still help." The Twelve-Eyed Beast looked at Lin Yuan and said again.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan nodded.

"Here are the materials and treasures you wanted."

The Twelve-Eyed Beast's mind slightly moved, and several treasure wonders emanating profound auras floated in front of Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan also took out the Time Sand he had prepared.

...

"These materials should be able to transform the Origin Clock to the peak of the Second Realm."

In the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan began to reforge the Origin Clock.

The large batch of lord-level raw materials he purchased was enough for the Origin Clock to evolve for a while.

...

Wanwei Space-Time.

Lin Yuan continued to advance deeper.

"Is this the deep area?"

Crossing a certain boundary, Lin Yuan immediately felt the pressure of space-time around him increase significantly, understanding that he had entered the depths of Wanwei Space-Time.

Here, even second-level lords have the possibility of falling.

"I must also be careful."

Lin Yuan, albeit confident, wasn't going to be too flamboyant; he immediately restrained his aura and randomly chose a direction to explore.

Time passed.

Eight thousand years went by in the blink of an eye.

"I've acquired treasures worth approximately two hundred thousand catties of Time Sand."

Lin Yuan flew within the deep regions of Wanwei Space-Time, feeling quite satisfied.

Here, the probability of discovering treasures is indeed much higher than in the outer regions.

Though treasures worth two hundred thousand catties of Time Sand are far less valuable than the Time Mountain, the latter is considered a great opportunity, not something one encounters frequently.

"Boom——"

An unusual aura emanated from afar, with seven distinctly different forces interweaving.

"What is that?" Lin Yuan looked from afar.

In that area filled with seven forces, Lin Yuan vaguely saw a small ten-meter-high tree, radiating seven colors, each emitting distinctly different aura waves.

"Is this the Seven Deities Treasure Tree?" Lin Yuan's pupils slightly contracted.

The Seven Deities Treasure Tree, a thirteenth-tier supreme wonder, is worth millions of catties of Time Sand.

The use of the Seven Deities Treasure Tree is to make a Time Lord's body tend toward perfection.

In endless ages past, there was a path of transcendence alongside the 'Perfect Soul,' known as the 'Perfect Body.'

The goal was to nurture a perfect mind from a perfect body.

However, eventually, a lord proved that this 'Perfect Body' path couldn't lead to transcendence.

Nevertheless, transforming the body to reach a perfect level can enhance a Time Lord's strength.

And the Seven Deities Treasure Tree can promote the perfection of the body.

Although the Seven Deities Treasure Tree can't directly make the body perfect, it can bring it close to perfection.

Even so, for Time Lords, this wonder is extremely valuable, with the listed price being millions of catties of Time Sand, though it's practically priceless.

"Many Time Lords are already eyeing this Seven Deities Treasure Tree."

Lin Yuan noticed around the Seven Deities Treasure Tree, there were seven or eight auras, all at the peak of the second level Time Lords.

Now, since the Seven Deities Treasure Tree has yet to mature, these seven or eight peak-level Time Lords haven't made a move, merely standing off against each other.

"I must compete for it."

Lin Yuan gazed from afar at the Seven Deities Treasure Tree, craving it intensely within his heart.

The Martial Arts Evolution Road specializes in the physical body, making this treasure, which greatly nurtures the body, a necessity for Lin Yuan.

Even though Lin Yuan was already at the peak of the second level eight thousand years ago, and despite not yet establishing the 'Tai Shi' method, his strength has grown significantly over the eight thousand years, equivalent to a second-level lord past the nine billionth tribulation.

"Seven or eight peak-level second-level lords, plus those hiding in the shadows, if I want to compete, I must fight swiftly and decisively, and retreat immediately once I have it."

Lin Yuan also hid nearby, silently watching the soon-to-mature Seven Deities Treasure Tree.

Just several decades passed.

The seven forces spreading from the Seven Deities Treasure Tree began to subtly merge.

"Is it now?!"

Lin Yuan suddenly erupted, his body rising with terrifying Tai Chu force, the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao surged like a sharp sword piercing through the lords' sealed area, suddenly appearing beside the Seven Deities Treasure Tree.
